interface Nested { config: { readonly count: number }; }
interface Nested { config: { count: number }; }
interface Optional { config: { count?: number }; }
interface Optional { config: {}; }
interface Callable { callback: (value: { readonly count: number }) => void; }
interface Callable { callback: (value: { count: number }) => void; }

interface Valid { config: { name: string; count: number }; }
interface Valid { config: { count: number; name: string }; }
